verdict.rationale: Shortcut documents a public REST v3 API for building integrations and automating workspace workflows, with CRUD endpoints (e.g., create/delete Category, list Category Milestones) and claimed Swagger/OpenAPI specs. Nothing in the evidence states or shows API-to-UI parity across features like Docs, Roadmaps, Goals, templates or automations, and probes did not find the OpenAPI spec at common paths. Missing for 10: an explicit API-to-UI parity statement, documented API coverage of UI features beyond core entities (Docs, Roadmap, Goals, templates, iteration automations), a locatable machine-readable spec, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: You can use this API to build custom integrations or automate even more of your workspace’s workflow.
Create Category allows you to create a new Category in Shortcut.
Delete Category can be used to delete any Category.
We provide machine-readable versions of our API specified in Swagger and OpenAPI.
